name: GoatCounter
composeYaml:
services:
  goatcounter:
    image: 'arp242/goatcounter:2.7'
    environment:
    volumes:
      - 'goatcounter-data:/home/goatcounter/goatcounter-data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:8080/status >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1'
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

meta.about: Easy web statistics without tracking of personal data.
